purpose: Test torus-consistent topology, not geodesic flow, on independent samples

first_phase_split.unit: paired initial-position group, all four conditions kept together

ratemap.missing_bin_fill: nearest occupied bin, discovery only; retain occupancy counts

cell_identification.inactive: zero spatial variance on discovery maps
cell_identification.bias_exclusion: discovery mean firing above 99.75 percentile of active neurons
cell_identification.grid_score: unmodified author GridScorer, annuli inner=0.2 outer=linspace(0.4,1,10)
cell_identification.grid_like_mask: discovery GCS > 0.3; validate scores without changing mask
cell_identification.paper_rotation: 360 SAC rotational Pearson coefficients, UMAP Euclidean n_neighbors=20 min_dist=0.05 random_state=72003; DBSCAN eps=0.5 min_samples=30
cell_identification.paper_manual_clusters: NOT reused: cluster IDs 2/12/15 are dataset-dependent, manual merging is not a transferable classifier
cell_identification.primary_candidate: discovery-only Fourier band cells: dominant frequency >=1.5 cycles/box, axial power concentration >=0.5 in +/-15 degree sector; keep within +/-20% of median band frequency; three axial orientation groups must each have >=16 units and circular gaps within 60 +/-15 degrees
cell_identification.candidate_choice: one frozen Fourier candidate per source; no choosing the best PH cluster

topology.primary_data: unaveraged raw hidden states in frozen candidate neurons
topology.primary_metric: Euclidean, centered by discovery mean and scalar RMS normalized (no UMAP)
topology.landmark_rule: farthest-point sampling from all heldout trajectories, predetermined start index seed
topology.filtration_threshold: 0.5 quantile of landmark pair distances, fixed computational cutoff; record all censored bars
topology.signature: a nonzero filtration interval with exactly beta0=1,beta1=2,beta2=1; two H1 and one H2 lifetimes >=0.15 times median landmark distance; common interval >=0.05 times median distance; H1 second/third and H2 first/second lifetime ratios >=2
topology.score: minimum of second H1 and first H2 normalized lifetimes, set to zero unless all signature requirements hold

nulls.preserves: each neuron empirical marginal, fixed discovery selection, sample counts
nulls.additional_temporal_control: independent within-trajectory circular shifts, last 10 steps only; diagnostic

topology.p_value: (1 + null scores >= observed)/(B+1), Holm correction over at most two source candidates within each heldout split
topology.acceptance: both heldout splits signature positive, adjusted p<=0.05, field 47 and field 2 agree, 384 and 512 landmark sensitivity agree; diagnostic or discovery plots cannot count as acceptance
topology.scope: torus-consistent statistical evidence, not a proof of homeomorphism; Betti numbers alone do not uniquely determine topology

fallback.training_budget: up to 100000 minibatches per environment, log actual executed budget; do not claim full-budget completion prematurely

timewise.visualization: one discovery-fitted coordinate system, projection only

evidence_limitations: Public pretrained inference weights have no optimizer/seed history
Single environment is not Schoyen main three-environment reproduction
Finite-sample PH can have insufficient power; negative result does not prove no torus
